content.inputFormat: First line contains an integer T, the number of test cases. Each test case consists of two lines: the first line contains an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 15), the size of the array. The second line contains N distinct integers Ai (1 ≤ Ai ≤ 10^5) separated by spaces.
content.outputFormat: For each test case, output all non‑empty subsets of the given array, one subset per line. Elements inside a subset are printed in increasing order and separated by a single space. Subsets must be printed in the order produced by a depth‑first recursion that first includes the current element and then excludes it (after sorting the original array). No extra blank lines are required between test cases.

sampleTestCases.explanation: The array is sorted as [1,2,3]. The DFS that includes the current element before excluding it generates subsets in the shown order, skipping the empty set.
Sorted array [1,2] yields subsets {1,2}, {1}, {2} in the required order.
With a single element, the only non‑empty subset is the element itself.

solution.approach: Sort the array to guarantee that elements inside each subset appear in increasing order. Then run a depth‑first recursion starting from index 0. At each index we have two choices: include the current element (push it to the current list) and recurse, then backtrack and exclude the element and recurse. When the index reaches N we have built one subset; if it is non‑empty we output it. This "include‑first then exclude" order matches the required ordering. The recursion explores all 2^N possibilities, skipping only the empty subset.
solution.timeComplexity: O(T·2^N·N) – each of the 2^N subsets may be printed, and printing a subset of size up to N takes O(N).
solution.spaceComplexity: O(N) for the recursion stack and the temporary list that stores the current subset.

code.Java: import java.io.*;import java.util.*;public class Main{static void dfs(int idx,int[] arr,List<Integer> cur,StringBuilder sb){if(idx==arr.length){if(cur.isEmpty())return;for(int i=0;i<cur.size();i++){if(i>0)sb.append(' ');sb.append(cur.get(i));}sb.append('\n');return;}cur.add(arr[idx]);dfs(idx+1,arr,cur,sb);cur.remove(cur.size()-1);dfs(idx+1,arr,cur,sb);}public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{BufferedReader br=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));StringBuilder sb=new StringBuilder();int T=Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());while(T-- >0){int N=Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());int[] arr=new int[N];StringTokenizer st=new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());for(int i=0;i<N;i++)arr[i]=Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());Arrays.sort(arr);dfs(0,arr,new ArrayList<>(),sb);}System.out.print(sb.toString());}}
